title: Review record
description: The durable record of one chorus-review round: the data the review page is rendered from (chorus-review § Artifact). Vote arithmetic lives here and only here; operator rulings appear only as ruling_ref.

target.description: What was reviewed: a spec, a design, a PR, or the codebase.

mode.description: project-state: the ordinary round. pr-design: design review of a PR's approach.

round_context.description: The paragraph of concrete since-last-chorus deltas every brief carried.

bindings.description: Port providers and recovered failures for this round.

baseline_ref.description: The prior review record this round baselines against, if any.

tldr.description: Three sentences: what the chorus found; what the top five prioritizes; which 🔴 findings block public rollout.

roster.description: Every roster member's RSVP: joiners, seating, abstainers with reasons.

joiners.description: J: ordinary JOIN replies after the failure rule.

branch.description: proceed: J ≥ 3. re-asked-proceed: J < 3, abstainers re-asked once, then J ≥ 3. aborted: still J < 3.

seating_decision.description: Id of the seating DecisionRecord in decisions, when J ≥ 6.

register.description: The findings register, written before the vote.

tally.description: The consolidation matrix: one row per register entry that is not [unsupported].

conflicts.description: Genuine conflicts (Phase 3). Empty when there were none.

disputed.description: What is disputed and how the user-visible outcome differs.

outcome.description: arbiter-ruled: the arbiter port (default advisor()) ruled. unresolved: left for the operator.

arbiter_ruling.description: The arbiter's ruling. It annotates the ranking and never changes counted severity. Not an operator ruling.

decision_ref.description: Unresolved only: id of the decision in decisions that carries it to the operator.

top_five.description: The ranking, drafted by the conductor. Held findings are excluded.

pull_quote.description: Copied verbatim from the register entry.

value.description: Risk reduced + friction removed + decisions unblocked.

constitutional_roi.description: Only when the addendum lists principles.

convergence.description: P + C from the tally row.

arbiter_note.description: A conflict ruling or sanity-check note that annotates this entry.

held.description: Findings with NEED_INFO still open at ranking.

route.description: The S11 path the last resolution attempt took.

decision_ref.description: Operator path: id of the decision in decisions that carries the ask.

baseline.description: What the next round should assume.

reports.description: File or memory-dir paths of its finding and vote reports.

rulings_cited.description: Standing operator rulings this round relied on.

local_rulings.description: Fallback only, when no ruling sink is bound: rulings held in this record, cited as record '#'.
